nodes.rationale: Form keeps Nordic-store leftovers: country select limited to Norge/Sverige/Danmark (default NO), 4-digit postal code, Vipps payment badge.

nodes.rationale: App Service row is priced as '1 instance baseline (730 hr)' while the deployed plan and the calculator steps use 2 instances.

nodes.label: Application Insights telemetry (Optimization #1, Monitoring & Operations)
nodes.rationale: Original Optimization #1 was App Service Plan autoscale (CPU 70/30, min 2 max 4); 'az monitor autoscale create' kept returning ResourceNotFound (suspected Azure CLI bug), so the team pivoted to Application Insights with a linked Log Analytics workspace, which still satisfies the two-optimization rule.

nodes.norm_label: azure app service plan + web app (standard s1, linux, node 22, 2 instances)

nodes.label: Azure Storage Account + Blob container 'products' (Standard_LRS)
nodes.rationale: Docs say product images are served from Blob Storage, but no code in server.js or public/js references Blob storage or STORAGE_BLOB_BASE; the container appears provisioned for the rubric only.

nodes.label: Azure SQL Database (DTU S0)
nodes.rationale: server.js only creates and writes dbo.Orders; products are not stored in SQL even though the cost report says it 'Stores Products and Orders tables'.

nodes.label: System-assigned Managed Identity on Web App (security control)
nodes.norm_label: system-assigned managed identity on web app (security control)
nodes.rationale: Satisfies D2 row 4. The report diagram routes SQL access through the identity, yet the app authenticates to SQL with SQL_USER/SQL_PASSWORD app settings via getSqlConfigFromEnv.

nodes.label: Azure Portal Screenshot Index
nodes.rationale: Captions overstate app behavior: 09-app-catalog says the grid is 'rendered from Azure SQL' and 11-app-checkout says it proves 'the cart-to-SQL persistence path works end-to-end', but the catalog renders client-side product data and the checkout submit handler (validation.js) only writes localStorage; no client code calls /api/checkout. Capture procedure also says 'All 8 screenshots' while 12 are listed.

nodes.rationale: Small catalog makes SQL reads negligible and static assets few; single-region Japan East keeps cost inside Azure for Students credit; Application Gateway WAF is overkill for a demo and not free-tier eligible.

nodes.label: SQL_ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variable (no hardcoded secrets)
nodes.rationale: Password is set per shell session and never committed, meeting the rubric's zero-secrets rule for Method A scripts.
